HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Far wide night: tiny Kangrim sitting alone on a salt-coast pier, shoulders shaking, emptied; black harbour water as most of the frame. LEFT sheet = mortal Kangrim face; RIGHT = Bulim / Land of Water rite board for glass, salt coast, harbour — ignore board faces. ONE device: the pier as a thin pale strip into void. Most drained and mad. Hex #4a4a58 as a single cold moon-catch on wet planks — not a body glow. No text. No watermark.
